title: Three Weeks and One Short Tray
subtitle: 饮食健康 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）
meta: 主题语境：饮食健康（人与自我·生活与健康·饮食与健康）　|　核心词汇：milk　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 milk 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the baker ① poured the milk that no customer in the bakery would have noted, and he said the pouring was the whole of the week. The ② milk, meaning the drink itself and not the tray, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; milk, he said, is the only thing in a bakery that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ piece of milk in that bakery had the same short tray beside it, and the ④ milk at the far oven, meaning the slice they kept for the children to taste and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Milk, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the baker said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the milk was the whole of the matter, meaning the care and not the drink. The ⑥ milk, meaning the care and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; milk, he said, is either something you pour or the only word that means both drink and a care. He said the care is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ milk had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short tray. The ⑧ milk of the whole thing, the baker wrote in December, was one bakery and three weeks of noting; milk, he said, is either the slice at the far oven or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ milk I remember is the milk noted in the bill, which closed in 1970 and is still noted as the quietest in the bakery. ⑩ Milk, my mother said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all milk, she said, is a care that has agreed to look like drink. She said the care was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 牛奶；乳汁（指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 牛奶；乳汁（指那杯牛奶本身，与薄薄的托盘相对）
C. 固定搭配：pour the milk 倒这一杯牛奶
D. n. 牛奶；乳汁（指留给孩子们尝的那一片）
E. n. 牛奶之事（抽象总称，指一处糕饼铺的牛奶之事）
F. n. 牛奶；乳汁（指账单里写到、被记下的那一杯）
G. n. 牛奶、滋养（指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 滋养（抽象总称，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: poured the milk that no customer in the bakery would have noted
The milk, meaning the drink itself and not the tray
Every piece of milk in that bakery
the milk at the far oven
the milk was the whole of the matter
the milk had become a line in a bill
The milk of the whole thing

answers.why: pour the milk 意为“倒这一杯牛奶”，1963 年那位面点师把糕饼铺里没有一位顾客肯记下的一杯牛奶做了一遍。
milk 意为“牛奶；乳汁”，指那杯牛奶本身而不是薄薄的托盘，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
milk 意为“牛奶；乳汁”，指糕饼铺里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一只薄薄的托盘。
milk 意为“牛奶；乳汁”，指最远那座炉口的留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
milk 意为“牛奶、滋养”，指一件事里人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这杯滋养就是那件事的全部。
milk 意为“滋养”，指人人都尝却无人提起的那样东西而不是那杯牛奶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
milk 意为“牛奶；乳汁”，指账单里写到、被记下的那一杯，到 1968 年这一杯成了账单里的一行。
milk 意为“牛奶之事”，面点师十二月写道，整件事的牛奶之事是一处糕饼铺和三个星期的记下。
milk 意为“牛奶；乳汁”，我记得的是账单里记下过的那一杯，1970 年卖完了，至今仍被说成糕饼铺里最安静的一杯。
milk 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，牛奶是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的牛奶。

最远那座炉口那杯牛奶，指的是他们留给孩子们尝的那一片，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（milk）
